grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Present progressive: they are + verb-ing
grammarPoints.rule: Use 'are' + verb-ing to talk about what a group is doing right now. Ask 'What are they doing?' or 'Are they + verb-ing?' Answer 'Yes, they are' or 'No, they aren't'.
grammarPoints.pattern: What are + subject + doing? They're + verb-ing. / Are + subject + verb-ing? Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: want + infinitive
grammarPoints.rule: Use 'want to' + a base verb to say what someone wants to do. Ask 'Do you want to...?' or 'What does he/she want to do?' Use 'wants' (not 'want') with he or she.
grammarPoints.pattern: I/you want to + verb. He/She wants to + verb. Do you want to...? What does he/she want to do?
